text:
Alex C.: Heads-up — Verdant private deployment booked for Tue 03:30-04:30 UTC (maintenance window). Need: rollout owner, smoke-test owner, and a rollback-ready on-call. Planning to push v2.1.3 -> private cluster (VPC).

deploy-bot: slot reserved for verdant-private-prod on 2026-04-07T03:30:00Z by @alexc — infra pool: dedicated-2, estimated runtime 25m. See /deploys/verdant/v2.1.3.

Karen L.: I can own rollout and monitor metrics (CPU, GPU, tail latency). Will be oncall during window.

Mike S.: I can run smoke tests and validate model responses. Will prepare prompt set and a health-check script.

Priya R.: Quick question — are there any DB migrations or secret rotations bundled?

Alex C.: No DB schema changes. There is a key rotation for customer KMS that was staged last week but not applied; we will NOT rotate during this window. Only model + runtime container bump and network ACL tweak (allow new egress to metrics endpoint).

Juan M.: I can be rollback on-call. If we need a rollback, is the plan to revert the k8s deployment to v2.1.2 and restore DNS weight?

Alex C.: Yes — rollback steps: 1) scale new deployment to 0, 2) kubectl rollout undo to v2.1.2, 3) restore NGINX upstream weight to 100% v2.1.2, 4) validate smoke checks. Full steps in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/verdant-private-deploy (see section "fast-rollback").

Mike S.: Smoke test checklist I'm going to run (will post script):
```
# quick smoke.sh
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $VERDANT_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"summarize: small prompt"}' \
  https://private-verdant.redwood/api/generate | jq '.status, .tokens'
# check latency distribution
./query-latency --target private-verdant --percentiles 50,95,99
```

Karen L.: Monitoring hooks:
- Grafana: dashboards/verdant-v2
- Traces: sampling 100% for first 10m, then 10%
- Alerts: 5xx rate >1% for 5m, p95 latency >1200ms for 3m
Will open a temporary alert silence for planned noise.

Priya R.: Who will update customer contact and Slack channel? I can ping account team and Verdant SOC to expect a short disruption if rollback happens.

Alex C.: Priya please handle customer comms. Add them to the post-deploy join link (we'll have a quick call if any anomalies).

Mike S.: Added the smoke script to the deploy checklist and will post results as code blocks here. Also will run the following post-deploy validation set (sanity + edge prompts).

Juan M.: One more: confirm KV cache warmup strategy. If the new model has different tokenization, responses could be cold. Any plan?

Alex C.: Runtime will pre-warm with a small corpus (10k tokens) and we will enable prefix caching only for 15m post-deploy. Not expected to affect correctness.

Oliver G.: Network note: ACL change to allow egress to metrics-ingest.redwood.net:443. Change is ready in staging; Karen, can you approve the apply window?

Karen L.: Approved. Apply during the first 5 minutes of the window, after we've pushed the pod image but before we shift traffic.

deploy-bot: deploy plan created: verdant-private/v2.1.3 -> rolloutStrategy: Canary(10%->50%->100%), canary-pause: 5m, smoke-tests: auto-trigger.

Alex C.: Proposed timeline:
- 03:30: start maintenance hold
- 03:32: push image + k8s apply
- 03:35: canary -> 10% traffic (5m pause)
- 03:40: run smoke tests (Mike) + check alerts
- 03:45: canary -> 50% (monitor 5m)
- 03:51: finalize to 100% or rollback if failures
- 04:00: post-deploy validation & notify Verdant

Mike S.: Got it. Will prepare the prompt list now and attach to the runbook.

Priya R.: I'll notify account/ops and put Verdant SOC on standby.

Karen L.: I'll create a temporary dashboard share and a short runbook summary in the channel. :white_check_mark:

Alex C.: Thanks all. If no objections I'll mark this thread accepted. Post any blockers ASAP.

Oliver G.: No blockers from infra side.

Mike S.: No blockers. All set.

Juan M.: Ready for rollback if needed.

Alex C.: Cool — locking schedule. Will update the runbook with final artifact links and attach the smoke test results after the window.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled for 2026-04-07T03:15:00Z to @Karen L., @Mike S., @Priya R., @Juan M., @Alex C.."
